record.title: Run acquired-input derived capability comparison
record.intent: Test identity and option preservation while selecting MHO984D software capability.
requirements: Execute only if the stock control passed; otherwise record the blocked arm without launching it.
Run one derived-copy guest experiment with fresh-process and same-guest reboot reloads.
Require MHO984 identity, MHO984D selected record, raw/effective enum18 before and after ParseOption, unchanged entire option catalog and exact seed files.
Require the exact admitted native transformation, original consumer observations, no installer/regeneration, healthy guest state and complete journals.
Stop on discrepancies; seal, commit and push results before evaluation. No physical access or RF claim.
acceptance: A verified comparison or bounded failure is preserved.
